This shared table is the '''Errata''' section on the English original and [[K'lor'slug (Errata)|PC Errata]] articles. Use '''Edit errata''' on a member page. Columns are Original and PC Errata (Appendix A lore drops ''hologram''; D-E1 stamp). Do not add Unlimited, Japanese, foil, or (V) columns. {{tl|Errata hl}} only the words or values that changed.
